entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM
entities.description: A substate of EMM-REGISTERED indicating the UE is attempting to update mobility management context. Reached when a combined attach or combined tracking area updating procedure succeeds for EPS services only.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Registration procedure for both EPS and non-EPS services.

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure to update tracking area and possibly other parameters for both EPS and non-EPS services.

entities.name: EPS services only success
entities.description: Condition where combined procedure succeeds for EPS services but not for non-EPS services.

entities.name: User data and signalling communication allowed
entities.description: Property indicating user data and signalling information may be sent and received in this state.

relations.description: Successful combined attach procedure for EPS services only establishes the EPS-only success condition.
Successful combined tracking area updating procedure for EPS services only establishes the EPS-only success condition.
EPS-only success condition leads to entering the EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM state.
Being in EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM state allows user data and signalling communication.
